text: {"775":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"MIR local variables are represented by indexed locals in rustc_middle's MIR definitions."},"776":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"The MIR representation stores both source locals and compiler temporaries as locals."},"777":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"MIR debug-variable annotations map source variable names to MIR places."},"778":{"about":["rustc_middle","rustc_mir_transform"],"refers":[],"why":"MIR debug-place mappings are represented in rustc_middle and may be altered or complicated by MIR optimizations."},"779":{"about":["rustc_middle","rustc_mir_build"],"refers":[],"why":"Closure-capture debug mappings use MIR debug information represented in rustc_middle and produced during MIR construction."}}
